title: Time-Embedding Transformer-Based Remaining Lifetime Prediction of Organic Coatings: From Short-Term EIS Monitoring to Long-Term Performance Evolution
summary: PMC full text Methods/Results: modified time-embedding transformer predicts degradation and remaining lifetime from |Z|0.01Hz for nine coating-environment combinations; results use measured EIS, adhesion, morphology and OCP through failure, then derive failure threshold and remaining life. Separate model/check per combination.
organization: Key Laboratory of Carbon Fiber and Functional Polymer, Ministry of Education, Beijing University of Chemical Technology
